chunks.text: Northwind Traders is a fictional speciality food importer. This handbook is synthetic sample content for the RAG Agent Studio demo; any resemblance to a real company is coincidental.
Our core hours are 10:00 to 16:00, Monday to Friday. Outside core hours you can start and finish when it suits you, as long as you work 37.5 hours a week.

Everyone gets 25 days of annual leave a year, plus public holidays. Leave builds up from your first day. Book leave in the HR portal at least two weeks ahead; your manager approves it.
You can carry up to five unused days into the next year. They must be used by the end of March.
If you are ill, tell your manager before 10:00 on your first day off. For absences longer than seven days, upload a fit note to the HR portal.
Claim expenses within 30 days, with a receipt, through the finance portal. Travel is booked through the travel desk. Economy class is standard for flights under six hours.
You can work from home up to three days a week. Agree the days with your team, and keep your calendar up to date so colleagues know where to find you.
Everyone gets a laptop, a headset and a monitor. Report lost or stolen equipment to the IT service desk within 24 hours.
